headline: Molecular diagnostics, epidemiology, and genomics of vector-borne diseases.
subtitle: Understanding how, where, and when vector-borne diseases spread.
perspective_heading: A pathogen’s genome tells one part of the story. The place and people around it tell another.
perspective_body: Our research brings these perspectives together. We study malaria and other vector-borne infections across laboratory and field settings, asking how they spread, change, and sometimes escape detection. The goal is evidence that helps surveillance reflect what is happening on the ground.
description: Kayode Lab at James Madison University studies vector-borne disease through field epidemiology, molecular diagnostics, and pathogen genomics.
